mintAuthority.summary: The tracked hyUSD SPL mint has mint authority CfuSViqf6wvUKEprLhtuCsSanvfAsMbDmkAW92FP95qe and no freeze authority. Hylo V2 documentation describes independent SOL-LST, cbBTC, HYPE, and USDC collateral pools, including direct USDC minting and redemption. At finalized Solana slot 452213587, the config admin remains Squads vault 12DAP8y5XemtK1pJFNMVVnQugt3PUAbZZr9SmyVvy4Ce, with 3-of-5 voters and a 7,200-second timelock. Both tracked programs name GzyhwK4y7EKPEevAMc2TEpgi1Y3znwj14FUzkHmCMiNP as upgrade authority. Its current Squads account has 3-of-4 voters and a 21,600-second timelock; upgrades can replace the program's mint logic.

controls.label: hyUSD mint-authority PDA of the Hylo exchange program
controls.capDescription: The SPL mint authority remains the exchange-program PDA. Published Hylo V2 issuance includes SOL-LST, cbBTC, HYPE, and direct USDC pools; the USDC pool is documented as one-for-one conversion subject to a Pyth USDC/USD tolerance. The earlier LST-only mint-path description was a V1 observation. This review does not certify an exhaustive current instruction inventory or replace the existing economic-cap annotation.
controls.evidence: Solana RPC getAccountInfo (jsonParsed) on mint 5YMkXAYccHSGnHn9nob9xEvv6Pvka9DZWH7nTbotTu9E at slot 432850547 returned mintAuthority = CfuSViqf6wvUKEprLhtuCsSanvfAsMbDmkAW92FP95qe, freezeAuthority = null, decimals 6, supply 11551873818410. CfuSViq... is off-curve and is not an initialized account. It is a signer-only PDA, reproduced exactly as findProgramAddress(["mint_auth", hyUSD mint], HYEXCHtHkBagdStcJCp3xbbb9B7sdMdWXFNj6mdsG4hn) with bump 254. Transaction GfB3KWeeBLrpXAx7rzNQQ3oMY5THhshBU1UN4x58Pq2hggZwPENmCeZsNwJiBH4zczSwvTPEhh9JrdJARjBVrFz (slot 432848270) shows HYEXCHt... at CPI stack height 2 invoking SPL Token mintTo with authority CfuSViq..., proving only the exchange program can sign hyUSD mints.

controls.label: Hylo protocol parameter admin (Squads v4 multisig vault, 3-of-5)
controls.capDescription: The admin can change fees, the SOL/USD oracle, oracle confidence tolerance, stability thresholds, treasury, the LST registry and the admin key itself, but the IDL exposes no mint-cap instruction and no admin mint path, so it cannot mint hyUSD or raise a cap.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 452213587, Hylo config 9cd2sAfbBvKs4SX9YKo4dcjwP3TgTVQ8dT5koshGcDND still names admin 12DAP8y5XemtK1pJFNMVVnQugt3PUAbZZr9SmyVvy4Ce. Squads v4 account 8CRxGZ3vJLsogg61tF7VHfpyMMaz4YVXX7qwxNDKciRt decodes to threshold 3, time_lock 7200, zero config_authority, and eight members, five with Vote permission. The earlier July observation was 1-of-4 with no timelock; it no longer describes the current quorum.

controls.label: Hylo program upgrade authority (Squads v4 multisig vault)
controls.capDescription: Redeploying the exchange program can rewrite mint logic and lift the collateral invariant that bounds the documented issuance paths. The current Squads upgrade authority has a 21,600-second timelock and is not renounced.
controls.evidence: At finalized Solana slot 452213587, exchange ProgramData BA5b6FzvZ77m7MZbsMEVSCFW1x86f7jM98wjcecVwzYN and router ProgramData GCsBXReXttZUUfG1JVxiXMvWPHbWikS3FVdZPy1hjXjM both name upgrade authority GzyhwK4y7EKPEevAMc2TEpgi1Y3znwj14FUzkHmCMiNP; their last deployment slots are 447625876 and 439863765. Transaction 2HPScPw3pcKxgFmUC9qkWWXYtgtayWRjB9ts1BHJyJURkTwczxGSSDooKXUyZx3aWwvBwGMNmo475VwwR3kGQNvd at slot 450122381 links that vault to Squads account 14Ajz35nKp4KUkHaLxucKfwCEKUeXaRCCuDYXqzK5NJm. At finalized slot 452214410 that account decodes to threshold 3, time_lock 21600, eight members and four Vote-permission holders. July's separate DLkcqeNNX8nRQgD87DN7LjHkcLQd9K2wuqaCbhkERJxL authority and untimelocked quorum are historical.

review.evidence: Current control facts were rechecked on 2026-10-01 at finalized Solana slots 452213587 and 452214410. The parameter-admin quorum is 3-of-5 with a two-hour Squads timelock; the current upgrade vault is GzyhwK4y7EKPEevAMc2TEpgi1Y3znwj14FUzkHmCMiNP, with 3-of-4 voters and a six-hour timelock. July's 1-of-4 parameter admin and untimelocked DLkcqeN upgrade vault are retained as historical observations in the controls. The mint remains a legacy SPL mint with the same mint-authority PDA and null freeze authority. Published V2 documentation includes SOL-LST, cbBTC, HYPE, and USDC pools. Existing economic-posture annotations are not reclassified from these control observations alone.
